items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: René used to come over there with Morris French and Morris French's brother with the tuba

ctx.x: I never saw any music. I never saw no band use any music except, the first band I saw use music over there was Leonard Parker's band. And then Parker was a good spell a little bit and he used to, I saw him with music. But the rest of them I never saw anyone with no music. And then also René used to come over there with Morris French and Morris French's brother with the tuba, playing the tuba at the different time, used to come over there and they wrote it.

items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever work with George Lewis? ... INTERVIEWEE: Yes. ... INTERVIEWEE: George Lewis was a player with Rainy, too.

ctx.x: Well, I think he was pretty good, you know, doing well at it.

Now, he know all them fellas down there. They been down there. They been down there. They come out Jones' home out there. Like Lewis Armstrong. They all come out there. Renny come out there. Joe come out there. Lewis come out there. Shots too, huh? I know Black Ben didn't come out of Jones' home. I believe he did. A whole bunch of them come out.
